description: Allocate a total party budget (USD) across seven categories (venue, food and drink, cake, decorations, entertainment, favors, contingency) by spending style, with per-guest spend and saving tips. Use when deciding what to spend before booking. Do NOT use to estimate attendance or food quantities (use headcount_plan).

budget.description: Total party budget in USD, positive, e.g. 600

guests.description: Number of guests, whole number 1-500, e.g. 30

style.description: Spending style that sets the category percentages: 'budget', 'standard' (default) or 'premium'

name: party_budget

allocation.description: Budget split per category; amounts sum to the budget

percent.description: Percent of the budget for this category

currency.description: Currency of all amounts, always USD

per_guest_budget.description: Total budget divided by guests, rounded to cents

title: Party budget
